affiliation: none; independent reimplementation of a published interface
exact_contracts: response model reports the SemIf model that answered
probabilities sum to 1 over declared options
probabilities, noul, score, and confidence serialize as JSON floats
prompt_sha256 equal to the equivalent semif-score JSONL row
no truncation; over-budget questions are rejected

noul.default_true_description: The answer to the question is yes.
noul.default_false_description: The answer to the question is no.

confidence.name: normalized-peak-v1
confidence.caveat: TypeSafe publishes this as the explainer's calculation and does not publish its production statistic verbatim; thresholds tuned against live Jev may not transfer

direct-options-v2.slots: A-Z then two-letter uppercase codes, frozen table
direct-options-v2.evidence: none; must not become the default before authored and perturbation workloads are re-run and committed

routing.note: reuse paths are numerically distinct from fresh scoring; pin with SEMIF_MODE when one fixed path is required

error_body_owner: SemIf; TypeSafe does not publish an error body schema
temperature_policy: default 1.0; the fitted per-workload values in docs/CALIBRATION.md are workload-specific and are not defaults
known_divergences: Choice capped at 16 options in phase 1
confidence formula may differ from Jev production
score ordinality carried only by level text and order
lower quality: 0.845 vs 0.883 on the aligned 102-row subset
